name: lookout
description: Supervise the coding agents of one project running in herdr panes: discover them, route their questions to a supervisor session, answer what is reversible and escalate what is not; launch a batch of 3-tier pendientes in worktrees, one agent each, with idempotent prompt delivery; enforce goalspec governance before a push, publish in order, close pendientes by journal and relieve agents; approve trivial tool permissions of the executors once, by rules the user activated (manual mode only), and send the rest to the user.
